title: Send NDA
summary: Prepare a mutual NDA for a potential partner or vendor and send for signature.

parts.title: Generate NDA from template
parts.guidance: Choose the NDA template that fits the disclosure: parties, purpose and whether information flows one way or both. Populate the legal entities and identify changes needed to scope, permitted recipients or duration. Keep unresolved business and legal choices visible in the draft, with a redline showing departures from the company’s usual terms.

parts.title: Review NDA terms
parts.guidance: Check the NDA against the planned discussion: confidential-information scope and exclusions, permitted use, recipient access, compelled disclosure and return or destruction duties. Escalate unfamiliar restrictions or rights beyond confidentiality to counsel. Agree acceptable changes with the business owner and identify the signer, then preserve the final negotiated version for execution.

parts.title: Send for e-signature
parts.guidance: Prepare the approved NDA for the verified entities and signers, with the correct capacities, attachments and signature order. Send that version through the company’s agreed contract-signing process. Track its signature request and return proposed changes for review before signatures are collected on a revised version.

parts.title: Track signature status
parts.guidance: Check for delivery failures, unsigned parties, declined requests and proposed edits. Verify that completed signatures belong to the intended signers on the same approved version. Follow up through the contract owner as needed. Confirm the agreement’s effective status for the planned disclosure before the team shares the covered information.

parts.title: File executed copy
parts.guidance: File the executed NDA and signature evidence with the relevant relationship or deal. Record the covered parties, purpose, effective date and notice or return obligations the team needs to follow. Keep amendments linked and superseded drafts distinct so future users can identify the agreement that governs their disclosure.

metadata.supportReason: System generates NDA from template, populates company data, and sends via DocuSign API. Fully automatable with approval gate.
